channels.name: TCK
channels.purpose: Test Clock. Tester-generated free-running clock; FSM samples TMS + TDI on the rising edge; TDO updates on the falling edge.

channels.name: TMS
channels.purpose: Test Mode Select. Drives the 16-state TAP FSM transitions; sampled on TCK rising edge. TMS=1 × 5 TCKs forces TestLogicReset.

channels.name: TDI
channels.purpose: Test Data In. Shift input to selected register (IR in ShiftIR, selected DR in ShiftDR); sampled LSB-first on TCK rising edge.
channels.idle_level: Recommended pulled HIGH (defaults to BYPASS opcode all-1s)

channels.name: TDO
channels.purpose: Test Data Out. Shift output of selected register; driven LSB-first on TCK falling edge; high-impedance outside ShiftIR / ShiftDR.
channels.active_levels: Per-device VOH / VOL when driven; high-Z otherwise

channels.name: TRST
channels.purpose: Optional asynchronous Test Reset (active LOW). When LOW, forces TAP FSM to TestLogicReset independent of TCK / TMS.

global_signals.name: VDD-IO (per device)
global_signals.purpose: Drives the TAP pins' I/O voltage; per-device datasheet.

global_signals.name: GND
global_signals.purpose: Common ground reference for the tester and all devices in the chain.

handshake_pairs.name: TCK_DRIVE
handshake_pairs.rule: Free-running clock; one FSM transition per rising edge; one TDO update per falling edge.

handshake_pairs.name: TMS_FSM
handshake_pairs.rule: TMS sampled on rising TCK drives the 16-state FSM transition table; all devices step in lockstep.

handshake_pairs.name: TDI_TDO_SHIFT
handshake_pairs.rule: In ShiftIR / ShiftDR: TDI sampled on rising TCK shifts into LSB of selected register; previous MSB exits on TDO on falling TCK.

handshake_pairs.name: TRST_RESET
handshake_pairs.rule: TRST=LOW asynchronously forces TAP FSM to TestLogicReset.

dependency_graph.common_rule: Tester drives TCK + TMS + TDI; reads TDO. FSM is driven entirely by TMS sampled on rising TCK; shift registers shift on rising TCK; TDO updates on falling TCK. The tester is fully in control of every cycle.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: Each ShiftIR/ShiftDR bit moves one position per TCK; TDI input becomes LSB of the selected register; previous MSB exits on TDO on the falling edge. In a daisy chain the per-device shifts compose into one long shift visible at the tester.

fields.ic_name: IEEE 1149.1 JTAG TAP Controller (TI SSYA002C primer)

boundary_scan_cell_catalog.purpose: Capture pin value in CaptureDR (observability); also receives functional path value when test logic is disabled.
Drive pin from BSR in EXTEST UpdateDR (controllability); capture driven value in CaptureDR for SAMPLE.
Combination of input + output cell; direction selected by an associated control cell.

boundary_scan_cell_catalog.associated_pin: Drives the OE / direction of an associated bidir cell
boundary_scan_cell_catalog.purpose: Allows EXTEST/INTEST to control the direction of bidirectional pins; not a separate physical pin.

ordering_rules.shift_bit_order: LSB first on TDI and TDO.
ordering_rules.daisy_chain_bit_order: First bit out of the tester (TDI) is the bit destined for the device farthest from the tester; last bit out is the bit destined for the first device (closest to the tester's TDI). Tester software is responsible for the per-device bit ordering.
